Let's make ice cream! 🍦 📝  Recipe Ingredients 2 eggs 1 cup heavy cream 1 cup whole milk 200g dark chocolate ¾ cup sugar Directions 1. Crack the eggs into a bowl. 2. Add sugar and whisk until smooth. 3. Heat milk and cream in a pan until warm. 4. Melt the chocolate into the warm milk mixture. 5. Slowly pour into the egg mixture and stir. 6. Pour everything into an ice cream machine. 7. Churn for 25–30 minutes until thick and frozen. Scoop into a bowl and enjoy! #interactive #icecream #chocolate #fypシ
